_doc: ClaimComposer questionnaire. Questions appear one at a time; 'condition' decides whether a question shows. Options for question 1 come from knowledge/data/eclass_routing.csv plus the extra options below. Only short structured fact fields exist: percent, number with a fixed unit, year, date, ID and choice. There is no free text.

questions.help_en: Choose the ECLASS segment. If you speak for the company, choose 'Company as a whole'.
A public website or social media always counts as reaching consumers.

questions.prompt_en: What do you want to communicate?
questions.help_en: Only topics that fit the product and audience are shown.
Facts are optional. Empty facts stay as placeholders such as [X].

questions.prompt_en: When will it be used, and was the product on the market before 27 September 2026?

segment_refinements._doc: Shown as a follow-up to question 1 where a segment's note says that a product rule depends on the class. The chosen option keeps only product rules whose product_domains meet these domains.
